#### **Dental Veneers in Austin and Round Rock TX**

At Forest Family Dentistry we provide custom dental veneers across all five of our Austin and Round Rock locations for patients who want to correct, enhance, or completely transform their smile. Veneers are one of the most versatile and impactful treatments in cosmetic dentistry and our team has the experience and artistry to deliver results that look genuinely natural and feel completely like you.

‍

#### **What Are Dental Veneers?**

Dental veneers are ultra-thin custom shells made from porcelain or high quality composite material that are bonded to the front surfaces of the teeth to improve their shape, size, color, and overall appearance. They are strong, stain resistant, and designed to blend seamlessly with your surrounding teeth so that no one can tell where your natural tooth ends and the veneer begins.

Veneers are an excellent solution for teeth that are chipped or cracked, severly stained or discolored in ways that whitening cannot address, worn down from grinding or aging, slightly misaligned or uneven in shape, or have small gaps between them that affect the overall look of the smile.

‍

#### **Traditional Porcelain Veneers**

Porcelain veneers are the gold standard of cosmetic smile transformation. Each veneer is custom crafted to match the exact shape, size, and shape that suits your face and your goals. The process typically takes two appointments. At the first visit we prepare the tooth by removing a small amount of enamel, take impressiona or digital scans, and place a temporary veneer. At the second visit your permanent, laboratory crafted veneers are bonded in place and any final adjustments are made. The results are beautiful, durable, and built to last well over a decade with proper care.

‍

#### **HALO® Veneers: No-Prep, No-Injection, No Downtime**

For patients who want the look of veneers without any enamel removal or anesthesia, HALO® Veneers offer a remarkable conservative alternative. **Available at our Anderson Lane and Round Rock locations**, HALO® Veneers use carefully layered and sculpted composite material to create a symmetrical, radiant smile without any drilling or injections at all. The entire transformation can often be completed in a single visit and because no tooth structure is removed the treatment is completely reversible if you ever want to change course. They are ideal for patients who want meaningful cosmetic improvement with the least invasive approach possible.

‍

#### Why Option Is Right for You?

The best veneers option depends on what you are hoping to correct, how much change you are looking for, and your personal preferences around the treatment process. Some patients are great candidates for HALO**®** Veneers and love the idea of walking out the same day with a transformed smile. Others have more significant concerns that call for the strength and customization of traditional porcelain. At your consultation our team will listen to your goals, evaluate your teeth honestly, and help you decide which approach makes the most sense for your situation without pushing you toward anything you are not comfortable with.

‍

#### Financing Your Veneers

We believe everyone deserves to feel confident in their smile and we work hard to make cosmetic dentistry as accessible as possible. We offer flexible options and our team will help you understand your payment options before your treatment begins so there are no surprises.

‍

If you are searching for dental veneers or HALO**®** Veneers in Austin or Round Rock TX, we would loveto start with a consultation. Book online or give your nearest Forest Family Dentistry location a call and let us show you what is possible.

#### **Gum Therapy and Periodontal Maintenance in Austin and Round Rock TX**

At Forest Family Dentistry we provide gum therapy and periodontal maintenance across all five of our Austin and Round Rock locations for patients dealing with gum disease at any stage. Gum disease is one of the most common dental conditions in adults and the tricky part is that it often develops quietly, without pain or obvious symptoms, until it has already started causing real damage. The good nes is that with the right treatment it is very manageable, and our team is here to help you get your gum health back on track.

‍

#### **What Is Gum Therapy?**

Gum therapy, also called scaling and root planing, is a deep cleaning treatment that goes below the gumline to remove the plaque, bacteria, and hardened tartar that regular brushing and flossing simply cannot reach. Once that buildup is removed, the root surfaces of the teeth are smoothed so that gum tissue can heal properly and reattach, reducing the pockeets where bacteria like to hid and cause ongoing damage. It is a non-surgical treatment and for most patients with early to moderate gum disease it is highly effective on its own.

‍

#### **What to Expect During Treatment**

Your comfort is always the priority. We gently numb the area before we begin so you should not feel anything beyond mild pressure during the procedure. Most patients complete their treatment over two appointments, treating one side of the mouth at each visit so the other side can begin healing while we work. After treatment many patients notice their gums feel less puffy and tender within just a week or two as the inflammation starts to resolve.

‍

#### **What Is Periodontal Maintenance?**

Once gum therapy is complete the work does not stop there. Patients with a history of gum disease are more susceptible to it returning, which is why we recommend periodontal maintenance visits every three to four months rather than the standard six month cleaning schedule. These visits are more thorough than a routine cleaning and focus specifically on monitoring pocket depths, controlling bacterial buildup below the gumline, and catching any signs of recurrence early before they become a bigger problem. With consistent maintenance most patients are able to keep their gum disease well controlled and their natural teeth for life.

‍

#### **Signs You May Need Gum Therapy**

Gums that bleed when you brush or floss, persistent bad breath that does not go away with normal hygiene, gum recession that is making your teeth look longer than they used to, sensitivity near the gumline, or teeth that feel loose are all signs worth taking seriously. None of these symptoms are normal and all of them are worth bringin up at your next visit. The earlier we catch gum disease the simpler and more comfortable the treatment tends to be.

‍

#### **Gum Disease Treatment at Forest Family Dentistry**

Our Austin and Round Rock hygiene teams use gentle techniques and modern technology to treat gum disease at every stage. We create personalized care plans based on what we actually see rather than a one size fits all approach, and we will always explain exactly what is happening and why before we recommend any treatment.

‍

If you have been told you need a deep cleaning or you have concerns about your gum health in Austin or Round Rock TX, do not put it off. Give us a call or book online at your nearest Forest Family Dentistry location and we will take great care of you.

#### **HealthyStart® in Austin TX with Dr. Amanda Hartman**

At Forest Family Dentistry's Burnet Road location in Austin, Dr. Amanda Hartman provides airway focused dental care for children through the HealthyStart**®** system. If you have a child who snores, grinds their teeth, breathes through their mouth, wets the bed, or seems chronically tired no matter how much sleep they get, there is a good chance that an airway issue is at the root of it. HealthyStart® was designed specifically to address these issues early, during the years when a child's jaw and airway are still actively developing, so that bigger problems down the road can be avoided entirely.

‍

#### **What Is HealthyStart®?**

HealthyStart® is an early orthodontic and airway treatment system that uses a series of soft, comfortable oral appliances worn during sleep or for short periods during the day. The appliances are custom fitted to each child and work gently over time to encourage nasal breathing, guide the teeth into proper natural alignment, support healthy jaw and facial development, and open up the airway so children can breathe freely while they sleep.

Unlike traditional braces, HealthyStart**®** does not involve brackets or wires and it is completely non-invasive. Most children adapt to the appliances quickly and parents often start noticing improvements in sleep quality, behavior, and focus within the first few months of treatment.

‍

#### **Signs Your Child May Benefit from HealthyStart®**

Many parents are surprised to learn that some of the most common childhood struggles have a dental and airway connection. Your child may be a good candidate for a HealthyStart**®** evaluation if they snore or make noisy breathing sounds during sleep, grind their teeth at night, breathe through their mouth during the day or while sleeping, wake up tired even after a full night of sleep, struggle with focus or attention during the day, have been diagnosed with ADHD or behavioral concerns, experience restless sleep or bedwetting, have crowded or crooked teeth coming in, or have chronic congestion, dark circles under the eyes, or recurring ear infections.

None of these symptoms are things to just wait it out. Early evaluation can make an enormous difference in a child's development, health, and quality of life.

‍

#### **Why Early Treatment Matters**

The years between ages two and twelve are a critical window for jaw and airway development. Addressing breathing and alignment concerns during this time takes advantage of natural growth process, which means results are faster, more comfortable, and longer lasting than trying to correct the same issues in adolescence or adulthood. Many HealthyStart**®** patients also reduce or eliminate the need for traditional braces later on, which is an outcome parents understandably love.

‍

#### **Meet Dr. Amanda Hartman**

Dr. Amanda Hartman is a certified HealthyStart**®** provider and one of the most experienced airway focused dentists in Austin. With over fifteen years of clinical experience and a genuine passion for pediatric development and whole body wellness, she brings a level of expertise and warmth to this area of care that is rare to find. She takes the time to thoroughly evaluate each child, explain her findings in plain language, and build a treatment plan that fits your child's specific needs and your family's schedule.

If you are looking for a HealthyStart® provider in Austin TX or wondering whether your child's sleep or breathing concerns have a dental connection, we would love to help. Book a consultation with Dr. Hartman at our Burnet Road location and let us take a closer look.

#### **Oral Surgery Services in Austin & Round Rock, TX**

At Forest Family Dentistry we offer a range of oral surgery services across our Austin and Round Rock locations, handled in house by our experienced team using modern techniques and technology. We know that the words "oral surgery" can feel intimidating, but our goal is always to make the process as comfortable, clear, and stress free as possible from your very first consulation through your recovery.

‍

#### **Tooth Extractions**

When a tooth is severly damaged, deeply infected, or causing crowding that affects the rest of your smile, a gentle extraction is sometimes the best path forward for your long term oral health. Our team focuses on making extractions as comfortable as possible and will walk you through exactly what to expect before, during, and after the procedure so there are no surprises.

#### **Removal of Over-Retained Baby Teeth**

Baby teeth that do not fall out on their own can interfere with permanent teeth coming in properly and may affect jaw development over time. We safely and gently remove over-retained baby teeth to help everything come in the way it should.

#### **Dental Implant Placement**

Dental implants are the gold standard for replacing missing teeth and we place them right here in our offices. A titanium post is anchored into the jawbone where it fuses naturally over time, creating a stable and long lastin foundation for a custom crown that looks, feels, and functions just like a natural tooth.

#### Bone Grafting

If there is not enough bone in the jaw to support a dental implant, bone grafting can rebuild and strengthen that area so implant placement becomes possible. It is a straightforward procedure that opens the door to tooth replacement for patients who may have been told they are not candidates elsewhere.

#### Gum Surgery

For patients with advanced gum disease that has not responded to non-surgical treatment, targeted gum surgery can reduce inflammation, eliminate infection, and protect the support structures that keep your teeth in place.

#### Gum Grafting

Gum recession exposes the roots of your teeth, which can cause sensitivity, affect the appearance of your smile, and leave teeth more vulnerable over time. Gum grafting restores that tissue, protects exposed roots, and gives your smile a healthier, more even look.

#### When We Refer Out

While we handle many oral surgery procedures right here in our offices, there are cases where a specialist is the best option for you. When that happens we coordinate closely with trusted local oral surgeons in the Austin area to make the transition seamless and make sure you are in excellent hands every step of the way.

‍

#### **Zoom® Teeth Whitening in Austin and Round Rock TX**

At Forest Family Dentistry we offer Zoom**®** professional teeth whitening across all five of our Austin and Round Rock locations for patients who want a noticeably brighter smile quickly, safely, and without the guesswork of over the counter products. Zoom® is one of the most trusted and widely used professional whitening systems in the country and the results speak for themselves. Most patients leave their appointment with teeth that are up to eight shades whiter than when they arrived, and the difference is genuinely dramatic.

‍

#### **What Is Zoom® Whitening?**

Zoom® whitening is an in-office treatment that uses a professional strength hydrogen peroxide gel activated by a specially designed LED light to break up deep set stains inside the tooth structure. Because the gel is professionally formulated and the light accelerates the whitening process, Zoom reaches stains that over the counter strips and trays simply cannot touch, including the kind of deep discoloration that builds up over years of coffee, tea, wine, and natural aging.

‍

#### What to Expect at Your **Appointment**

The whole process takes about an hour and a half from start to finish and is completely comfortable for most patients. We begin by protecting your gums and lips so only your teeth are exposed to the whitening gel. We then apply the Zoom**®** gel to your enamel and activate it with the LED light. That cycle is repeated three to four times in sessions of about fifteen minutes each, and by the end of your last session your smile will already look dramatically different. Many patients are genuinely surprised by how fast it works.

‍

#### Your Take Home Kit Is Included

Every Zoom**®** whitening treatment at Forest Family Dentistry comes with a complete Philips Zoom® take home maintenance kit at no extra charge. You receive custom fitted whitening trays made specifically for your teeth, along with DayWhite and NiteWhite whitening gels and a storage case with easy to follow instructions. The take home kid lets you touch up your results on your own schedule and extend the life of your whitening significantly. It is one of the things that sets professional whitening apart from anything you can buy at the drugstore.

‍

#### How Long Do Results Last?

With normal care most patients enjoy their Zoom**®** results for one to three years. Avoiding heavy staining drinks like coffee, tea, and red wine right after treatment gives your enamel time to fully stabilize and helps the results last as long as possible. Using your take home kit for occasional touch-ups between visits keeps your smile looking consistently bright over time.

‍

#### Is Zoom**® Right for You?**

Zoom**®** Whiteing is a great fit for most adults who want faster and more dramatic results than at-home whitening can deliver. It is especially popular for patients getting ready for weddings, reunions, job interviews, or any occasion where they want to feel their most confident. If you have dental restorations like crowns or veneers it is worth nothing that whitening gel does not change the color of those materials, so we will discuss realistic expectations at your consultation to make sure you are happy with the outcome.

‍

#### **Sleep Dentistry in Austin with Dr. Purvi Pandya**

At Forest Family Dentistry's Research Boulevard location in North Austin, Dr. Purvi Pandya provides advanced dental sleep medicine care for patients struggling with sleep apnea, chronic snoring, and other sleep related breathing conditions. Sleep apnea is one of the most underdiagnosed health conditions in the country and left untreated it does not just affect how rested you feel. It raises the risk of high blood pressure, heart disease, stroke, and diabetes in ways that compound quietly over time. Dr. Pandya's work in this area is about far more than better sleep. It is about protecting your long term health.

‍

*"As dentists, it is our responsibility to address sleep as a core part of patient health. The more patients understand sleep apnea, the more empowered they become to make informed decisions about their well-being."* - Dr. Purvi Pandya

‍

#### **What is Dental Sleep Medicine?**

Dental sleep medicine focuses on treating obstructive sleep apnea and related breathing conditions through custom oral appliance therapy rather than relying solely on a CPAP machine. A CPAP is highly effective but many patients find the mask uncomfortable, claustrophobic, or simply impossible to sleep with consistently. For those patients oral appliance therapy offers a clinically supported and FDA approved alternative that is small, comfortable, completely silent, and easy to travel with.

‍

#### **Signs You May Have Sleep Apnea**

Because sleep apnea happens while you are unconscious, many people live with it for years without realizing it. Common signs include loud or frequent snoring, gasping or pausing in breathing during sleep that a partner notices, waking up with a dry mouth or sore throat, morning headaches, persistent daytime fatigue no matter how many hours you slept, and difficulty concentrating or staying focused during the day. If any of these sound familiar a sleep apnea evaluation is absolutely worth pursuing.

‍

#### **Who Is a Good Candidate for Oral Appliance Therapy?**

Oral appliance therapy is particularly well suited for patients with mild to moderate obstructive sleep apnea, patients who have been diagnosed with sleep apnea but cannot tolerate their CPAP device, patients who travel frequently and need a portable solution, and patients who snore significantly even without a formal sleep apnea diagnosis. Dr. Pandya works closely with physicians and sleep specialists to make sure every patient receives a thorough evaluation and the most appropriate treatment for their specific situation.

‍

#### **Meet Dr. Purvi Pandya**

Dr. Pandya is a Diplomate of the American Academy of Dental Sleep Medicine, one of the most respected credentials in the field, and brings over 23 years of clinical experience to her care at Forest Family Dentistry. Her approach to sleep dentistry is rooted in genuine collaboration with the medical community and a whole body philosophy that recognizes sleep as one of the most important pillars of overall health. Patients who see her consistently describe her as thorough, compassionate, and genuinely invested in outcomes that go well beyond the dental chair.

‍

#### Sedation Dentistry in Austin and Round Rock TX

At Forest Family Dentistry we know that dental anxiety is real and we take it seriously. Whether you feel a little nervous before appointments or the idea of sitting in the dental chair fills you with genuine dread, you are far from alone and we want you to know that we have helped countless patients just like you get the care they need comfortably and without fear. We offer nitrous oxide sedation across all five of our Austin and Round Rock locations for both adults and children and it has genuinely changed the dental experience for so many patients.

‍

#### **What is Nitrous Oxide Sedation?**

Nitrous oxide, commonly known as laughing gas, is a safe and gentle inhaled sedative that has been used in dentistry for decades. It is administered through a small, comfortable nosepiece that sits just under your nose during your appointment. Within a few minutes most patients feel a wave of warmth and relaxation wash over them, and that underlying nervousness that was there when you walked in tends to simply fade away.

You stay completely awake and aware during the entire procedure and can respond to your dentist and hygienist normally at any point. There are no needles involved and no oral medication to take beforehand. When your appointment is finished we simply remove the nosepiece and the effects wear off within minutes, which means you can drive yourself home and go right back to your normal day without any lingering grogginess or downtime.

‍

#### Who Is It a Good Fit For?

Nitrous oxide sedation works beautifully for a wide range of patients. If you experience anxiety or nervousness about dental visits, have a sensitive gag reflex that makes cleanings or procedures uncomfortable, have had a difficult or painful dental experience in the past that has made you hesitant to come back, are facing a longer or more involved procedure and want to feel more relaxed throughout, or have a child who feels scared about going ot the dentist, nitrous oxide is absolutely worth considering.

It is also a great option for patients who simply want to take the edge off without committing to a more involved form of sedation. You can request it for something as routine as a cleaning and there is no reason to wait for a big procedure to give it a try.

‍

#### **Is It Safe?**

Yes, nitrous oxide has one of the longest and most well established safety records of any dental sedative in use today. It is appropriate for most patients including children and has been used safely in dental offices for well over a century. Our team will review your health history before your appointment to make sure it is the right fit for you and answer any questions you have before we begin.

‍

#### How to Add Sedation to Your Visit

Just mention it when you call to schedule or bring it up at the start of your appointment. There is nothing extra you need to do to prepare and no prescription to pick up ahead of time. Our team will walk you through everything when you arrive and make sure you feel informed and comfortable before we begin.

‍

If you have been putting off dental care because of anxiety and you are looking for a dentist in Austin or Round Rock TX who truly understands, we would love to take care of you. Give us a call or book online at your nearest Forest Family Dentistry location and let us make your next visit genuinely different.

#### **Dental Crowns and Bridges in Austin and Round Rock TX**

At Forest Family Dentistry we create custom dental crowns and bridges for patients across all five of our Austin and Round Rock locations. Whether you are dealing with a tooth that has been cracked, severly decayed, or weakened after a root canal, or you are missing one or more teeth and want a fixed solution that looks and feels completely natural, our team has the experience and technology to restore your smile beautifully.

‍

#### **What Is a Dental Crown?**

A dental crown is a custom made cap that fits over a damaged or weakened tooth, restoring its shape, strength, and appearance. Think of it as a protective cover that brings the tooth back to full function while looking completely natural alongside your other teeth.

Crowns are most commonly used to protect a tooth that has been cracked or significantly weakened, restore a tooth after a root canal, cover a tooth with a very large filling that is at risk of fracturing, anchor one end of a dental bridge, or improve the appearance of a tooth that is misshapen or severly discolored. We use durable tooth colored materials like porcelain and ceramic so your crown blends seamlessly with the rest of your smile.

‍

#### **What Is a Dental Bridge?**

A dental bridge is a fixed restoration that replaces one or more missing teeth. It consists of an artificial tooth or teeth held in place by crowns that are bonded to the natural teeth on either side of the gap, or in some cases supported by dental implants. Once placed a bridge is permanent and functions just like natural teeth for chewing and speaking.

Beyond restoring your smile aesthetically, a bridge plays an important functional role. When a tooth goes missing the surrounding teeth tend to shift over time to fill the space, which can affect your bite, your jaw, and even the shape of your face. A bridge keeps everything where it belongs.

‍

#### **Which Option Is Right For You?**

If your tooth is still in place but damaged or weakened a crown is usually the right answer. If a tooth is missing entirely and you want a fixed non-removable solution, a bridge is worth discussing. Dental implants are another excellent option for replacing missing teeth and our team can walk you through the differences at your consultation so you can make the decision that feels right for your situation and your budget.

‍

#### **What to Expect**

Getting a crown or bridge at Forest Family Dentistry typically takes two appointments. At the first visit we prepare the tooth, take impressions or digital scans, and place a temporary restoration. At the second visit we bond your permanent, custom made restoration in place and make any final adjustments. Our team works closely with high quality dental laboratories to make sure every restoration we deliver looks natural, fits precisely, and is built to last.

‍

#### **What Is Air Polishing?**

Air polishing is a modern dental cleaning technique that uses a gentle stream of compressed air, warm water, and a fine powder made from glycine or erythritol to remove plaque, stains, and biofilm from your teeth and along the gumline. Air polishing works beautifully for just about anyone but it is especially beneficial if you wear braces or Invisalign**®** aligners, have dental impants, crowns, bridges, or other cosmetic restorations, experience surface staining from coffee, tea, wine, or tobacco, or simply want a deeper and more thorough clean before a whitening treatment. #### **Root Canal Treatment in Austin and Round Rock TX**

At Forest Family Dentistry we provide gentle, effective root canal treatment across all five of our Austin and Round Rock locations to relieve tooth pain, stop infection, and save your natural tooth. We know that the phrase "root canal" makes a lot of people nervous and we want to address that right away: the procedure has a reputation that is decades out of date. With modern anesthesia and the techniques our team uses today, most patients tell us the experience was nothing like what they were dreading and that the relief they felt afterward made them wish they had come in sooner.

‍

#### **What Is a Root Canal?**

Inside every tooth is a soft tissue called the pulp, which contains nerves and blood vessels. When decay, a crack, or trauma allows bacteria to reach that inner tissue it can become infected or severely inflamed, causing the kind of deep, persistent tooth pain that does not go away on its own. A root canal removes that infected tissue, thoroughly cleans and disinfects the inside of the tooth, seals it to prevent infection, and restores it with a filling or crown so it can function normally again. The tooth stays in place, looks completely natural, and with proper care can last a lifetime.

‍

#### **Signs You May Need a Root Canal**

The most common sings that a root canal may be needed include persistent toothache that does not let up, sharp sensitivity to hot or cold that lingers after the temperature source is gone, pain when biting or chewing, swollen or tender gums near a specific tooth, and a pimp-like bump on the gum that keeps coming back. Sometimes an infected tooth causes no obvious pain at all, which is one reason why regular dental visits matter so much. We screen for these issues at every exam so we can catch them early when treatment is simpler.

‍

#### **What to Expect During Treatment**

We start by thoroughly numbing the area so you should not feel pain during the procedure, only occasional mild pressure. Once you are comfortable we remove the infected pulp tissue, carefully clean and shape the root canals, disinfect the inside of the tooth, and seal everything to prevent bacteria from getting back in. Most root canals are completed in one or two appointments depending on the severity of the infection. Afterward we will placea crown or filling to restore the tooth to full strength and function.

‍

#### **What Happens If You Wait?**

A tooth infection does not resolve on its own. Left untreated it can develop into a painful abscess, cause bone loss around the root, spead to surrounding teeth and tissue, and ultimately result in losing the tooth entirely. Treating the infection early with a root canal is almost always far simpler, more comfortable, and less expensive than dealing with the consequences of waiting.

‍

#### **How Long Does a Root Canal Last?**

A properly treated tooth can last many years and in most cases a lifetime with normal care. Brushing twice a day, flossing daily, keeping up with your regular cleaning appointments, and protecting the tooth with a crown if one is recommended will give you the best long term outcome.

‍

If you are experiencing tooth pain or sensitivity in Austin or Round Rock TX do not put it off. Call your nearest Forest Family Dentistry location or book online and we will get you seen as quickly as possible.
